name: 36-45 dominoes
description: 36-45 dominoes refers to domino games with 36 or 45 tiles, or scoring to 36/45. Typically block or draw dominoes: match numbers on open ends, doubles crosswise, first out or lowest pips if blocked. Exact rules vary by region.

overview.description: 36-45 dominoes refers to domino games with 36 or 45 tiles, or scoring to 36/45. Typically block or draw dominoes: match numbers on open ends, doubles crosswise, first out or lowest pips if blocked. Exact rules vary by region.

history.origins: Domino games with 36 or 45 tiles (extended sets) or scoring to 36/45. Regional variants; block/draw core.

setup.deck: 36 or 45 tiles (extended set or scoring target)
setup.dealing: Tiles dealt per variant; remainder boneyard in draw games.

rules.objective: Play all tiles first, or have fewest pips if blocked; or reach 36/45 points in scoring variants.
rules.gameplay: Match to open ends; doubles crosswise. Block: pass if cannot play. Draw: draw until playable. Winner scores opponents' pips or lowest hand if blocked.
keyRules: Match to open ends; doubles crosswise

strategy.basic: Dump high tiles early; block when ahead.
strategy.intermediate: Block ends opponents need; track which numbers are in play.
strategy.advanced: Force block when you have few pips; leave awkward ends.
tips: Agree set size and block vs draw before play.
36/45 may refer to tile count or target score.

scoring.description: Block/draw variant: play all or lowest pips if blocked.
scoring.winCondition: First to play all tiles or lowest pips remaining.
